Lilla: luna, please stop hitting me, stop stealing my breath, I’m sorry… *cries*
Shinobu: luna apologize to Lilla right now!
Mitsuri: Why did you so suddenly hit Lilla?
Obanai: Don’t look at me like I am gonna save you, it’s embarrassing.
Gyomei : We are all really disappointed in you, luna.
Lilla: *runs to Muichiro amd hiccups* Muichiro, am I really that useless?
Muichiro: You’re great, unlike someone who steals breathing stuff and uses it. *pats Lilla’s head*
Giyuu: luna, apologize to Lilla now.
Tengen: No flashiness at all! Take that fake Hashira to the demons to be eaten!
Rengoku: I’m very disappointed in you, luna.
Sanemi: *hits you* Still standing there? Apologize to Lilla!
